visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Show and Hide a Password
visualizerParams.description: Type a password box with a button that switches the input between type password and type text. Changing the type attribute is all it takes.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
<input id="pw" type="password" value="secret">
<button id="eye">Show</button>
<script>
  var pw = document.getElementById('pw');
  var eye = document.getElementById('eye');
  eye.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var hidden = pw.type === 'password';
    pw.type = hidden ? 'text' : 'password';
    eye.textContent = hidden ? 'Hide' : 'Show';
  });
</script>

checks.label: A second click hides it again
